name: SpotiFLAC-Mobile
description: Mobile music utility built with Flutter and Go. High-quality audio management for your personal library. - open source, no ads, no subscription.
readmeExcerpt:
## Screenshots

--- ## Extensions Extensions let the community add new music sources and features without waiting for app updates. When a streaming service API changes or a new source becomes available, extensions can be updated independently. ### Installing Extensions 1. Open the **Store** tab in the app 2. On first launch, enter an **Extension Repository URL** when prompted 3. Browse and install extensions with one tap 4. Or download a `.spotiflac-ext` file and install manually via **Settings > Extensions** 5. Configure extension settings if needed 6. Set provider priority under **Settings > Extensions > Provider Priority** ### Developing Extensions > [!NOTE] > Want to build your own extension? The > [documentation site](https://spotiflac.zarz.moe/docs) contains the API reference. --- ## Development SpotiFLAC Mobile combines a Flutter/Dart UI, a Rust backend from [`rust_backend/`](rust_backend/), and thin Android/iOS platform bridges. See the [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup, Android and iOS builds, Full/Lite variants, crash symbols, validation, and pull request guidelines. --- ## Related Projects ### [SpotiFLAC (Desktop)](https://github.com/afkarxyz/SpotiFLAC) Download music in true lossless FLAC from extension-provided sources on Windows, macOS & Linux. ### [SpotiFLAC (Python Module)](https://github.com/BartolomeoRusso9/SpotiFLAC-Module-Version) Python library for SpotiFLAC integration, maintained by [@BartolomeoRusso9](https://github.com/BartolomeoRusso9). --- ## FAQ
Why does the Store tab ask me to enter a URL?
Starting from version 3.8.0, SpotiFLAC Mobile uses a decentralized extension repository system. Extensions are hosted independently rather than on a built-in server, so anyone can create and host a compatible repository. Enter a repository URL in the Store tab to browse and install extensions.
Why is my download failing with "Song not found"?
The track may not be available from your enabled providers. Try enabling more providers under **Settings > Extensions > Provider Priority**, or install additional download extensions from the Store.
Why are some tracks downloading in lower quality?
Quality depends on what's available from the source and the installed download extension. Check each extension's quality options and service notes in the app.
Can I download playlists?
Yes! Just paste the playlist URL in the search bar. The app will fetch all tracks and queue them for download.
Why do I need to grant storage permission?
The app needs a writable destination for downloaded files. On Android, choose a folder with the system folder picker (SAF), or use the app-specific folder. If Android revokes a saved folder grant, select the folder again in Settings.
Is this app safe?
SpotiFLAC Mobile is open source, so its code and build workflows can be inspected directly in this repository.
Why is downloading not working in my country?
Some countries have restricted access to certain streaming service APIs. If downloads are failing, try using a VPN to connect through a different region.
Can I add SpotiFLAC Mobile to AltStore or SideStore?
Yes! Add the official source to receive updates directly within the app. Copy this link: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spotiflacapp/SpotiFLAC-Mobile/refs/heads/main/apps.json ``` In AltStore/SideStore, go to **Browse > Sources**, tap **+**, and paste the link.

readmeHtml:
Screenshots

Extensions

Extensions let the community add new music sources and features without waiting for app updates. When a streaming service API changes or a new source becomes available, extensions can be updated independently.

Installing Extensions

  1. Open the Store tab in the app
  2. On first launch, enter an Extension Repository URL when prompted
  3. Browse and install extensions with one tap
  4. Or download a .spotiflac-ext file and install manually via Settings > Extensions
  5. Configure extension settings if needed
  6. Set provider priority under Settings > Extensions > Provider Priority

Developing Extensions

Note

Want to build your own extension? The documentation site contains the API reference.

Development

SpotiFLAC Mobile combines a Flutter/Dart UI, a Rust backend from rust_backend/, and thin Android/iOS platform bridges.

See the Contributing Guide for setup, Android and iOS builds, Full/Lite variants, crash symbols, validation, and pull request guidelines.

Related Projects

SpotiFLAC (Desktop)

Download music in true lossless FLAC from extension-provided sources on Windows, macOS & Linux.

SpotiFLAC (Python Module)

Python library for SpotiFLAC integration, maintained by @BartolomeoRusso9.

FAQ

Why does the Store tab ask me to enter a URL?

Starting from version 3.8.0, SpotiFLAC Mobile uses a decentralized extension repository system. Extensions are hosted independently rather than on a built-in server, so anyone can create and host a compatible repository. Enter a repository URL in the Store tab to browse and install extensions.

Why is my download failing with "Song not found"?

The track may not be available from your enabled providers. Try enabling more providers under Settings > Extensions > Provider Priority, or install additional download extensions from the Store.

Why are some tracks downloading in lower quality?

Quality depends on what's available from the source and the installed download extension. Check each extension's quality options and service notes in the app.

Can I download playlists?

Yes! Just paste the playlist URL in the search bar. The app will fetch all tracks and queue them for download.

Why do I need to grant storage permission?

The app needs a writable destination for downloaded files. On Android, choose a folder with the system folder picker (SAF), or use the app-specific folder. If Android revokes a saved folder grant, select the folder again in Settings.

Is this app safe?

SpotiFLAC Mobile is open source, so its code and build workflows can be inspected directly in this repository.

Why is downloading not working in my country?

Some countries have restricted access to certain streaming service APIs. If downloads are failing, try using a VPN to connect through a different region.

Can I add SpotiFLAC Mobile to AltStore or SideStore?

Yes! Add the official source to receive updates directly within the app. Copy this link:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spotiflacapp/SpotiFLAC-Mobile/refs/heads/main/apps.json

In AltStore/SideStore, go to Browse > Sources, tap +, and paste the link.

aiSummary.oneLiner: An open-source mobile music utility for managing and playing lossless FLAC audio with extension support.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: SpotiFLAC Mobile is an ad-free, subscription-free mobile application built with Flutter and Go for high-quality, local audio management. It provides a clean, modern interface for users to build and manage a personal library of lossless FLAC music, completely bypassing commercial streaming services. Available on both Android and iOS, it leverages a high-performance Go backend for fast scanning and playback without draining the battery or requiring internet access. The app features a decentralized extension repository system, allowing users to install community-developed plugins to add new music sources and features dynamically. This serves as a privacy-respecting alternative for audiophiles who demand complete control over their high-fidelity collections.
keyFeatures: Lossless Audio Focus: Dedicated entirely to high-fidelity FLAC audio format management and uncompressed, pristine playback.
Cross-Platform UI: Built with Flutter to ensure a beautiful, consistent, and responsive experience across Android and iOS.
High-Performance Backend: Utilizes Go for incredibly fast background processing, metadata scanning, and local file handling.
Decentralized Extension System: Supports community-developed extensions to dynamically add new download sources without updating the core app.
Ad-Free Offline Experience: Completely open-source with no advertisements, telemetry, or tracking, requiring absolutely no internet connection for playback.
Advanced Metadata Support: Reads and cleanly displays embedded album art, lyrics, and detailed audio tags.

useCases.title: Audiophile Music Collection
useCases.description: Manage large collections of high-resolution FLAC files on mobile without any quality degradation or compression.

useCases.title: Managing Large Local Libraries
useCases.description: Users with gigabytes of local music rely on the app's fast scanning to organize their tracks efficiently.

useCases.title: Offline Commuting
useCases.description: Commuters use the app to listen to their favorite albums in subway systems where internet connectivity is unavailable.

useCases.title: Privacy-Focused Playback
useCases.description: Listen to music without tracking, profiling, or algorithmic telemetry common in commercial streaming apps.

useCases.title: Extensible Source Integration
useCases.description: Users add custom extension URLs to integrate alternative, specialized music download sources directly into the app.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Music lovers, audiophiles, and privacy advocates who want a high-quality, local-only music player for their mobile devices. It is especially suited for users who prefer managing their own media files over renting them from streaming services.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Open the Store tab in the app and enter an Extension Repository URL to browse available extensions.
